description: Allowlist of companies with a public, scrapeable student program/apply page
audit_note: Batch 2026-08-08 (run 3): added AMD, Arm, Coursera, Elastic, Unity. Candidates re-audited; still parked. See docs/ADD_COMPANIES.md.

companies.name: Adobe
companies.notes: Public Student Ambassador page on adobeforeducation.com (legacy adobe.com/education/students/* ambassador URLs return 404).

companies.name: AMD
companies.notes: Public university program hub for educators, researchers, and students.

companies.name: Arm
companies.notes: Public Arm Education resources for students and educators learning embedded systems.

companies.name: Canva
companies.notes: Public education hub for students and teachers with sign-up and classroom program flows.

companies.name: Coursera
companies.notes: Public Coursera for Campus page for university online learning and student employability.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.notes: Public Databricks Academy training home with student and educator learning paths.

companies.name: Elastic
companies.notes: Public Elastic training hub with courses and certifications for students and professionals.

companies.name: Figma
companies.notes: Public higher-education landing page with student verification flow via figma.com/education/apply.

companies.name: GitHub
companies.notes: Public Campus Experts page. Legacy education.github.com/programs/campus-experts returns 404; education.github.com/campus_experts redirects to login.

companies.name: Google
known_programs: Google Developer Groups on Campus Lead
companies.notes: GDSC leads consolidated under developers.google.com/community (GDG on Campus lead content). Legacy students.google.com does not resolve.

companies.name: IBM
companies.notes: Public university student landing page with sign-up for free AI and career skills training.

companies.name: JetBrains
companies.notes: Public JetBrains Academy page with student learning paths and apply/get-started flows.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.notes: MSA lives at mvp.microsoft.com/studentambassadors (learn.microsoft.com/.../studentambassadors 404). Imagine Cup at imaginecup.microsoft.com; LEAP at leap.microsoft.com.

companies.name: MongoDB
companies.notes: Public MongoDB for Students / Student Pack benefits page (includes GitHub Student Developer Pack pathway).

companies.name: Notion
companies.notes: Public Notion for Education help hub including Campus Leaders program references and student signup guidance.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.notes: Public NVIDIA training hub with student and educator learning resources (DLI).

companies.name: Salesforce
companies.notes: Trailhead help article describing the Salesforce Student Program and how students can participate.

companies.name: Unity
companies.notes: Public Unity Education page for teaching real-time 3D and game development skills.
